2. Availability of Information
(a) Information on the planning process, including the citizen participation plan, the approved current CDBG application, CDBG performance reports, and CDBG program regulations shall be available for citizen review, during normal working hours.
(b) A summary of important elements of the program shall be published and widely distributed early in the planning process.
3. Technical Assistance
(a) Technical assistance will be provided to the CDBG Steering Committee and Area Committees. This assistance will include clerical support for providing minutes and technical support preparing the general recommendations of the Steering Committee and Area Committees. Individuals and groups will receive technical assistance in developing project proposals.
Citizen Involvement in Program Implementation
The CDBG Steering Committee will receive quarterly reports on the progress of projects included in the CDBG program. Meetings will be held on the area and Steering Committee level to discuss any issues which significantly affect the CDBG program.
Citizen Involvement in Program Amendments and Future Planning
1. Program Amendments.
Amendments to the CDBG program will be submitted to the CDBG Steering Committee for review and recommendation prior to submittal of the amended application to the City Council for approval. When the amended 
amended application to the City Council for approval. When the amendment involves a significant change in a particular neighborhood area, it will also be submitted to the Area Committee for review.
2. Future Planning
In the second and third year of the new Community Development Program, Area and Steering Committee meetings will be held to review and reevaluate the CDBG program for that year. Additionally, at least two public hearings will be held every year.
B. COMMUNITY ATTITUDES
During the preparation of the Community Development Block Grant program by the City Administration and the Steering Committee, several meetings and hearings were held to discuss the program, hear citizen ideas and proposals, and to decide upon target areas and specific projects.
